events.verdict: RAR shows Beal (WAS) attempts to slip the contact, but drives through Tucker (HOU) and dislodges him from his legally obtained position.
Tucker (HOU) makes clean contact with the ball on the pass by Beal (WAS).
Gordon (HOU) has a hand on the opposite side hip of Porter Jr. (WAS) but the contact is tactile in nature as he immediately removes it when Porter Jr. starts to move away.
Morris (WAS) engages with Tucker (HOU) and briefly clamps his right arm but immediately disengages when the shot hits the rim.
Harden (HOU) extends his right leg into Beal (WAS) on the jump shot attempt, but the contact is marginal.
Harden's (HOU) shot attempt does not hit the rim and there is a correctly called 24 second violation.
House (HOU) maintains a legal guarding position on the drive by Wall (WAS).
Tucker (HOU) maintains a legal guarding position on Porter Jr.'s (WAS) jump shot.
Green (WAS) makes clean contact with the ball during the rebound attempt.
Capela (HOU) sets the pick on Beal (WAS) from a wide stance but does not deliver any leg to leg contact.

LAR and MOB show Morris (WAS) is retreating on Harden's (HOU) drive to the basket and when he raises his arms to contest, he makes contact to the ball with his elbow. Any contact to the body is marginal.
RLB shows Gordon (HOU) makes contact with Wall's (WAS) right arm that affects his driving shot attempt.
Morris (WAS) makes marginal contact with Tucker's (HOU) arm that does not affect his ability to maintain control of the ball.
Harden (HOU) loses control of his dribble prior to any incidental contact by Green (WAS).
Tucker (HOU) wraps up Porter Jr. (WAS).
Capela (HOU) establishes himself in the path of Beal (WAS) when he absorbs the contact.
RAR and MOB show Tucker (HOU) makes contact with Wall's (WAS) arm that affects his jump shot attempt.
Wall (WAS) legally contests Gordon's (HOU) jump shot attempt and makes clean contact with the ball.
[Observable in enhanced video] Harden (HOU) slides his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Porter Jr. (WAS) cleanly steals the pass by Harden (HOU).
Beal (WAS) and Gordon (HOU) briefly engage and disengage.
Gordon (HOU) maintains a legal guarding position defending Green (WAS).
Green (WAS) gathers the ball and takes three steps.
Harden (HOU) grabs and wraps his arm around Wall's (WAS) leg and dislodges him from his legally obtained position.
House (HOU) and Porter Jr. (WAS) briefly engage and disengage following the screen.
Harden (HOU) maintains a legal guarding position on Wall's (WAS) jump shot attempt.
Capela (HOU) establishes himself in a screening position in Morris's (WAS) path and absorbs the contact.
Tucker (HOU) is not established in a screening position in Beal's (WAS) path and he delivers the contact.
Green (WAS) makes incidental "high-five" contact with Harden's (HOU) hand after the release of his jump shot attempt.
Tucker (HOU) backs into Green (WAS) and dislodges him, affecting his ability to contest the shot.
Capela (HOU) commits a take foul on Morris (WAS).
Harden (HOU) commits a take foul on Wall (WAS).
Morris (WAS) and Harden (HOU) engage and disengage on the perimeter on the inbound play.
Gordon (HOU) draws Green (WAS) into the air towards him, but Green would miss making contact with Gordon if he didn't lean to his right to initiate the contact.
Wall (WAS) legally contests Capela's (HOU) shot attempt at the basket.
Tucker (HOU) initiates body contact with Wall (WAS) that causes him to fall to the floor and lose control of the ball.
